title: textinput
summary: Benilla's textinput is the host routing needed because its engine-free UI cannot reach the OS clipboard or share an edit law (per-OS chord table, held X11/Wayland pasteboard handle, one EditBoxState law for glue + FrameXML fields). MSUI's text fields are ImGui InputText widgets (chat edit, character-create name, auction search, GM console, creator panels), which natively provide caret movement, selection, Ctrl/Cmd copy-cut-paste against the OS clipboard, and max-length caps - the observable effect Benilla builds by hand.
